sections.content_markdown: Once you get this book in your hand, a number of questions will be raised in your minds. - What is chemistry? Why should we learn chemistry? How will we be benefited from chemistry? Does it have any relation to other branches of science? - We shall learn the answers to these questions in this chapter.
